info.name: Credit and Debit Memos
info.description:
# Credit and Debit Memos API

Master-DB CRUD for `credit_memo` and `debit_memo`. Both store `branch_id` on the header. Billing lives on master; branch is validated against `billing_entry`.

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Query/body: `token`, `requester` (required on all endpoints)

## Branch IDs
| branch_id | Clinic |
|-----------|--------|
| 1 | Mobile |
| 2 | Oakridge |
| 3 | Mactan |
| 4 | Consolacion |
| 7 | Mantlewood |

## Accounts
- Credit memo: `debit_account_type_id` from payload; credit is always Trade Receivable (`account_type.code = 102-113`, leaf)
- Debit memo: `credit_account_type_id` from payload; debit is always Trade Receivable

## Status
`pending` (default) → `approved` or `disapproved`. Update and delete only while `pending`.

## Control no.
Generated on save: `CM`/`DM` + padded branch code + `YYYYMMDD` + 6-digit yearly series.

## Request body format
- **GET** — query params
- **POST** — multipart form-data

request.description:
## GET `/credit_memos/get`

List credit memos from master. `branch_id` is an optional filter.

### Query params
| Param | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `token` / `requester` | yes | Auth |
| `branch_id` | no | Filter |
| `credit_memo_id` | no | Filter by id |
| `billing_id` | no | Filter |
| `status` | no | `pending` / `approved` / `disapproved` |
| `date_from` / `date_to` | no | `date_issued` range (both together) |
| `page` / `data_size` | no | Pagination |


Each memo includes company_id/company_name from its linked billing and memo_entries for active, correctly owned child allocations. Each child includes patient_id, patient_name, transaction_no and booking_details using the same branch-aware enrichment as billing entries. Pending memo children are included when pending memos are selected. Missing context uses null values/empty arrays. Existing fields, size and pagination are preserved. Each memo_entries child also returns branch_name and invoice_no from its linked billing-entry context; transaction_no retains the branch-aware lookup. Unavailable values are null.

request.description:
## POST `/credit_memos/create`

Required: `billing_id`, `branch_id`, `debit_account_type_id`, `reason`, `amount`.

Server sets `date_issued` (today), credit account to Trade Receivable (`102-113`), `status=pending`, and generates `control_no`.

`branch_id` must match a non-deleted `billing_entry` for that billing.

Optional `memo_entries` is a nonempty array of `{billing_entry_id, amount}`. Example: `[{"billing_entry_id":101,"amount":"1000.00"},{"billing_entry_id":102,"amount":"500.00"}]` for header amount `1500.00`. Form-data uses `memo_entries[0][billing_entry_id]` and `memo_entries[0][amount]`. Ownership is derived from the header; supplied billing_id/branch_id must match. Entries must be active and belong to both billing and branch. Duplicate entry IDs, negative/over-precision amounts and unequal totals fail without saving. On pending update, supplied children replace active children; omitted children remain and must match the resulting header. Omitted children on create retain legacy behavior. On approval, explicit allocations subtract from stored entry balances for credit memos and add for debit memos, atomically with the billing-header update. Negative balances are allowed. Approval revalidates ownership/totals and cannot be applied twice. Legacy memos without children adjust the billing header only; existing historical stored entry balances are not backfilled.

item.name: Memo entry allocation examples
item.description: Use fixture billing-entry IDs belonging to the selected billing and branch. billings/get returns credit_memo_entries and debit_memo_entries on each matching entry, including empty arrays when none exist. Only approved, non-deleted memo parents are included, matching existing billing memo visibility. Each billing entry also returns credit_memo_total and debit_memo_total as two-decimal strings summing its visible child amounts (default "0.00"). Existing billing-level credit_memo/debit_memo arrays and totals are unchanged.

request.description: Optional term performs case-insensitive partial patient-name matching before pagination and count. Blank terms do not filter. Existing entry/collection filters remain active. Optional screen=credit_memo includes fully paid and negative-balance entries; omitted screen retains collection eligibility using positive memo-adjusted balances. Entry balance equals amount minus payments minus approved active credit allocations plus approved active debit allocations. billings/get retains its invoice-number search.
